root_cause: All TensorFlow layer tests passed (2114 passed, 0 failed). The job only failed in the 'Upload Test Results' step, where the upload-artifact action's FinalizeArtifact call to GitHub's Actions blob-storage backend received an HTML error page (an Azure/GitHub-hosted service error page) instead of the expected JSON response, on all 5 retry attempts over ~8.5 minutes. This is a transient GitHub Actions infrastructure/backend outage unrelated to the PR's code change (a small Python string-parsing fix in tools/ovc), matching a previously seen pattern (LLM accuracy iGPU run, 2026-09-04) where the same backend returned HTML instead of JSON during artifact finalization.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a GitHub Actions backend-side artifact service failure that occurs intermittently regardless of code changes.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'TensorFlow Layer Tests' job; the test suite itself passed and only the artifact upload step failed transiently.
No code changes required for PR #38105 - the failure is unrelated to the tools/ovc/openvino/tools/ovc/cli_parser.py change.
If this recurs frequently, consider adding a longer backoff/retry window to the upload-artifact action or reducing test-result artifact sizes to shorten the finalize window.
prevention_strategies: Monitor GitHub Actions status page for artifact/blob-storage incidents when this error recurs; consider wrapping the Upload Test Results step with a few seconds of delay/retry at the workflow level if recurrence increases. No application-code changes can prevent this since it is an external service fault.
historical_context: Same signature previously recorded on 2026-09-04 for an LLM accuracy iGPU tests run (PR #37898), also showing 'artifact blob storage returns HTML error page' during FinalizeArtifact. This is now a recurring (count=2) but infrequent infrastructure pattern, not clustered within a 12h window with the prior occurrence (over a month apart), so no Teams recurrence escalation is triggered this run.
